about_the_game:
The Game is simple, Cut down all the trees.....

A minimalist game about restoring nature’s balance in an overgrown forest or reclaiming an abandoned city lost to time. With only your axe and determination, carve a path through dense vegetation, collect valuable wood, and uncover the secrets hidden beneath the roots.

Game Features

  • Chop Down Trees – Clear the overgrowth and shape the environment around you.

  • Gather & Sell Wood – Collect resources to trade for better tools and upgrades.

  • Upgrade Your Axe – Start with basic tools and work your way up to more powerful equipment.

  • Manage Stamina – Pace yourself to avoid overexertion and injury.

  • Discover Hidden Secrets – As you cut deeper into the wilderness or the ruins, uncover the mysteries buried beneath the surface.

  • Restore & Reclaim – Transform the landscape, bringing life back to forgotten places
